name: Syncthing
author: omarchy-syncthing contributors
description: Syncthing status in the Omarchy bar: folders, devices, start/stop/restart, rescan, and quick access to the web UI or a TUI.

barWidget.description: Sync state, folders and devices, with service controls.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll while idle. The widget polls every 2 seconds while the panel is open or a folder is syncing.

schema.label: systemd user unit
schema.description: The user unit that start, stop and restart act on.

schema.label: TUI command
schema.description: Command to run in a terminal from the panel, e.g. stc. Leave empty to follow the Syncthing service log instead.
